name: Carrie Ford
title: Did you just find out you’re about to be a Dad? You need to read this!
body: Such a great read and full of great information. I bought this book for myself when my wife told me we are having a baby. I also bought her the “You will Rock as a Mom.” Great books; recommend for any first time parents.

name: DM
title: Extremely relatable
body: I’m very grateful that my fiancé bought me this when I mentioned it. There are aspects of how I was raised that made me very hesitant toward having children and this book encapsulates many insecurities very well. I’d recommend to anyone feeling anxious or insecure about being a parent.

name: Marisa Daboll
title: Worth the money
body: My boyfriend has actually taken the time to read this book despite busy military life. He has learned so much from it! Very happy with my purchase

name: Joseph Studioso-Marcus
title: Hey, Soon-To-Be Dads! This Book Rocks!
body: Liking the book so far! My wife (and mother-to-be) got this book for me as a very thoughtful Father's Day gift! Halfway through, this book has provided lots of practical advice accompanied by light-hearted commentary. To any soon-to-be parents reading this review, good luck on your journey!

name: Lauren Arditti
title: For Future Dads
body: As a mom, I picked this up hoping it would help my husband feel more prepared for our first baby, and I ended up reading much of it myself. I honestly wish more dads would read a book like this. What I appreciated most is that it doesn't just focus on diapers and hospital bags. It encourages fathers to understand what their partner is experiencing physically and emotionally, while also acknowledging that becoming a dad can be scary. I loved seeing the emphasis on communication, supporting your partner, looking after mental health, and becoming an active parent instead of just a bystander. It feels like the author genuinely wants dads to be confident, involved, and compassionate from pregnancy onward. The writing is approachable and often funny, which makes it an easy read. There were several moments that made me smile because they captured the reality of pregnancy surprisingly well. As a mom, it was reassuring to see my experience validated while also giving practical advice to help fathers know what they can actually do. It's not perfect. Some of the humor and sports analogies won't resonate with everyone, and there are a few moments where the tone leans a little more casual than I personally prefer. There are also occasional product mentions that felt a bit promotional. None of those things took away from the overall value of the book for me. Overall, this is a thoughtful, encouraging guide that helps first-time dads become true partners during pregnancy and beyond. If you're expecting your first baby—or you're a mom looking for a book to give your husband—I would absolutely recommend this one. It offers practical advice, reassurance, and plenty of reminders that showing up with love and support matters more than being perfect.

name: Madison
title: So helpful for new dads
body: This is such a helpful tool for new dads navigating parenthood! I loved that it not only had helpful information on navigating all the different stages of having a new child, but also how you can support your partner through all the trials on childbirth and recovery

name: Taylor
title: Great read
body: I bought both of these books for my partner and he loves them!

name: Alexis Schneider
title: Pre-Baby
body: i’m a father-to-be coming in Feb 2027 and this book has been amazing i’m not even a reader but ever since i got the news i been tryna invest in as much as i can to becoming a great father and husband at the same time.. this book has made me feel like im talking to a friend about what’s going on! i recommending it so far into reading! i’ll lyk post baby if the book helped 😅🥴😂

name: EatMorChikin
title: Detailed Information
body: This book is very detailed in everything first-time fathers need to know. There are different sections that explain what to do though each stage. It’s a good book for the wife to get the husband.

name: Amazon Customer
title: Solid Practical Advice
body: This is a helpful and encouraging guide for first-time dads who may be feeling overwhelmed by pregnancy and all the changes that come with it. I appreciated how the author walks through each stage of pregnancy, explains what dads can expect, and offers practical ways to support their partner. The sections on prenatal visits, birth plans, postpartum challenges, and preparing for the baby's arrival were especially useful. The writing is easy to follow, and the advice is realistic without being intimidating. A solid resource for any man getting ready to become a father.
